text:
Maya: FYI I just got a pager for embeddings latency from incident-bot. p95 in apac jumped to ~1.8s, a few customer timeouts reported. linking logs and short trace: <https://internal.redwood/logs/trace/abc123>
incident-bot: Pager R-2026-74 | service: embeddings-api | symptom: p95 latency > 1s for 10m | region: apac | severity: high | links: <https://internal.redwood/incidents/R-2026-74> :rotating_light:
Arun: I'm currently marked as secondary for APAC but my calendar shows primary. can someone confirm primary/secondary for tonight?
Sam: I'm primary for the shift until 20:00 UTC. Arun, I think your oncall rotation moved you to backup last week — checked the roster.
Arun: ah okay, my bad. Sam — can you take lead on the pager?
Sam: taking lead. first quick check: are KV cache hit rates for embeddings down? Maya, can you paste the last 5m cache metrics?
Maya (oncall): cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 58% around 17:12 UTC. memory pressure spike on embed-node-3. logs show recurring eviction messages: `evicting oldest entries to free 1.2GB`
Priya: sounds like autoscaler kicked in then OOMs on embed-node-3 later? any restarts?
Maya (oncall): embed-node-3 restarted at 17:18 UTC (kube). pod came back but cache warmed slowly, explains latency spike.
Jules: Are we still routing traffic to that node? router shows weight 10% on embed-node-3. we should drain it until we verify cache behavior. Run this: `kubectl cordon pod/embed-node-3 && kubectl drain pod/embed-node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Sam: doing safe drain now. will also bounce instance to clear any leaked mem.
incident-bot: Update: R-2026-74 | action: node drained | actor: Sam | time: 17:31 UTC
Arun: quick note — there was a config difference between embed pools in apac and euw: `cache.eviction.threshold` set to 0.7 in euw but 0.4 in apac. That explains faster eviction. Opening PR to align to 0.65: <https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7812>
Priya: nice catch. can we temporarily raise the threshold in apac to 0.6 via feature flags while we roll the config PR?
Sam: yes, will flip feature flag for apac to 0.6 (safe toggle). doing it now.
Maya (oncall): feature flag toggle applied at 17:38 UTC; monitoring cache hit rate...
Maya (oncall): cache hit rate recovering: 58% -> 81% over 6 minutes, p95 latency dropping to ~650ms
Sam: good. customer impact: a handful of requests returned 504 between 17:10-17:20 UTC for one enterprise customer in apac. I opened a customer incident and notified CSM.
Priya: Can we add a temporary routing rule to route new requests to euw for that customer to avoid further failures? Sam, can you coordinate with routing?
Sam: will add per-customer routing override for the next 2 hours. done at 17:45 UTC.
Jules: add runbook pointer for whoever picks this up next: embeddings-latency runbook -> <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency>. also add the config PR and node name in the incident doc.
Maya (oncall): incident doc updated: <https://internal.redwood/incidents/R-2026-74> — summary, timeline, actions, PR link, and customer note added.
Arun: for handoff: Sam will remain primary until 20:00 UTC and is leading the mitigation. Maya is logging and monitoring. I'll follow up with infra team to prioritize the config PR for a safe rollout tomorrow morning APAC low-traffic window.
Sam: next steps: 1) monitor p95 for 30m, 2) validate embed-node-3 after restart for memory leak signs, 3) expedite PR review and schedule config rollout, 4) confirm customer backfill if needed.
Priya: tagging runbook owners: @Jules please follow up on routing and any long-term autoscaler tuning.
Jules: will do — planning a follow-up sync 10:30 PT tomorrow.
Maya (oncall): current status at 17:55 UTC: degraded -> recovering; p95 apac ~630ms, cache hit ~84%, no new 504s in last 10m. leaving monitoring on.
Sam: handoff notes for the next oncall: primary: Sam (until 20:00 UTC), secondary: Arun. watchlist: embed-node-3 memory, config PR #7812, routing override for impacted customer (expires 19:45 UTC). runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency>.
Arun: ack. if anything pages me, I'm reachable on mobile. good handoff. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: R-2026-74 | status: mitigated (service degraded -> recovering) | last update: 17:56 UTC
